name: form
need: Collect input: labelled fields in three looks, slots, states, checks and cards, form sections, filters, action bars and a composer

--ds-input-font.default: the size's role, else body; input role at 600px and below
--ds-input-font.description: fields: the type role of the text (its weight comes from `--ds-input-weight`)

--ds-input-weight.description: the weight of field text, also in the roles of the sizes

--ds-check-size.description: the drawn checkbox and radio (`.ds-check`, `.ds-checkbox`, `.ds-radio-input`, radio cards, table checkboxes): the base, 2px per size step

--ds-check-target.description: their halo (hover, press, focus) across: the base, 8px per size step and 4px per density step

--ds-input-height.description: fields: the base height (size md, comfortable density) of `.ds-input`, the search pill, input groups and a growing textarea, which size and density steps apply to ([options.md](options.md)); the combobox toggle lines up with it

--ds-input-padding-x.description: fields and input groups: the base side padding, 4px more or less per size step

--ds-check-height.description: a `.ds-check` row: the base height that size and density steps apply to (one line of its label; a longer label wraps and the box stays beside its first line)

--ds-radio-padding.description: radio and checkbox cards: the base padding, 2px less per density step

--ds-input-bg.description: the outlined field and the input group at rest (fill, 1px border colour, corners; the filled field's top corners)

--ds-input-border.description: the outlined field and the input group at rest (fill, 1px border colour, corners; the filled field's top corners)

--ds-input-radius.description: the outlined field and the input group at rest (fill, 1px border colour, corners; the filled field's top corners)

--ds-input-focus-color.description: the field's ring, the label tint while it has the focus, the filled field's bottom line, the input group and composer rings

--ds-input-grow-max.description: the tallest a `.ds-input--grow` textarea grows before it scrolls

--ds-field-error-color.description: the text of an error, a warning and a success hint (their icons stay `--ds-error`, `--ds-warning`, `--ds-success`)

--ds-field-warning-color.description: the text of an error, a warning and a success hint (their icons stay `--ds-error`, `--ds-warning`, `--ds-success`)

--ds-field-success-color.description: the text of an error, a warning and a success hint (their icons stay `--ds-error`, `--ds-warning`, `--ds-success`)

--ds-field-changed-color.description: the dot after the label of a `.ds-field--changed` (keep 3:1 on the surface)

--ds-check-list-max-height.description: `.ds-check-list` scrolls on its own beyond it (`none`: every row shows)

--ds-form-actions-bleed.description: how far a `.ds-form-actions--sticky` bar bleeds on a phone: set it on a padded container of the page's own to its inline padding (it inherits)

--ds-composer-max-height.description: the tallest the composer's textarea grows before it scrolls

ripple..ds-check: a checkbox row: the input's halo is the press
ripple..ds-checkbox: a checkbox input: the halo is the press
ripple..ds-radio-input: a radio input: the halo is the press
ripple..ds-input: native field parts (select, the calendar and clear buttons)

scroller..ds-input: textarea.ds-input--grow scrolls its own text: a textarea has no child elements

physical.select.ds-input, input.ds-input[list]: p: the room of the arrow, which sits at the right
physical..ds-field--inset > select.ds-input, .ds-: the room of the arrow in the inset box, whose padding-inline would take it away
physical.select.ds-input, input.ds-input[list]: b: the select arrow: two gradients placed from the right edge
physical.input.ds-input[list]::-webkit-calendar-p: the invisible picker laid over the arrow at the right

focus..ds-input: fields show an inset ring on any focus: typing needs to see where the caret is

height..ds-field__hint--error: the room of a validation message opens to auto on --ds-ease-out (D29), only where interpolate-size exists
height..ds-field__hint--success: the room of a confirmation under a field opens like a validation message's (D29), only where interpolate-size exists
height..ds-field__hint--warning: the room of a warning under a field opens like a validation message's (D29), only where interpolate-size exists
